objects.description: [SMOKEDHAM](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0649) has used Powershell to download UltraVNC and [ngrok](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0508) from third-party file sharing sites.(Citation: FireEye SMOKEDHAM June 2021)
objects.description_fa: [SMOKEDHAM](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0649) از Powershell برای دانلود UltraVNC و [ngrok](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0508) از سایت‌های اشتراک‌گذاری فایل شخص ثالث استفاده کرده است.(Citation: FireEye SMOKEDHAM June 2021)
